observations: Photo 0 shows a vintage-style sewing machine with a beige and cream-colored body.
The brand 'SINGER' is clearly visible on the top right of the machine in photo 0.
The machine has a large handwheel on the right side with a dial marked with numbers 1 to 6.
There is a needle and presser foot assembly visible in the center.
The machine appears to be in used condition with some dust and minor wear.
The background is a plain wall and a light-colored surface, possibly a table or counter.
No power cord, light bulb, or motor is visible in the photo.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.proof: A photo showing the light bulb and its socket, or a close-up of the machine's internal components.
risks.if_unproven: priced as without light, which reduces value

risks.risk: The machine may be damaged or non-functional.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
